newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues tender to buy June superior kerosene.
newsitem.headline: India issues tender to buy June superior kerosene.

text.p: India's state-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy superior kerosene for delivery in June, traders said on Monday.
The tender seeks 40,000-to-45,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender closes on May 8 and offers will be valid until May 9.

In its last tender, IOC bought 90,000 tonnes of kerosene in two cargoes for May delivery. The first cargo for May 11-20 delivery was awarded to Mediterranean trader BB Energy while the second for May 21-31 delivery was awarded to Shell, both at $34.84 per tonne above the high of Mediterranean quotes, on a c-and-f Indian east coast basis.
